nodes.name: Run OCR pipeline
nodes.notes: Requires docker CLI + socket in n8n container (deploy_n8n_alex.sh).

parameters.content:
## AlexandriaSandwich OCR

POST webhook path: `alexandria/ocr`

```json
{
  "job": "book-001",
  "pull": false,
  "push": false,
  "lang": "deu+eng",
  "threshold": 85,
  "limit": 0,
  "no_mistral": false
}
```

Runs on alex.local: n8n → n8n_run_job.sh → docker exec alexandria_worker run_pipeline.sh
